info.name: EasyClaim API (three-role model: customer, insurer admin, superadmin)
info.description:
Local demo collection for backend/ (the only API). Setup:
1. cd backend && npm install && npm run setup:local && npm run demo:setup:local && npm run dev
2. Either import the environment written by `npm run token -- --postman` (offline tokens), or create an environment with baseUrl = http://127.0.0.1:8787 and demoPassword = the DEMO_LOGIN_PASSWORD line of backend/.dev.vars (1234567), then run folder 00.
Roles: CUSTOMER, INSURER_ADMIN (one insurer role: verify..pay + own-tenant accounts), SUPERADMIN (platform admin, read-only on claims). Folder names still say assessor/manager in places: both are now the insurer admin (token_insurer_a / token_insurer_b).
Secrets never enter this collection. Folders 0, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11 are attack demonstrations; each request description states the expected response.
Contract: docs/API_CONTRACT.md.

item.name: 00 - Sign in (demo accounts)
item.description: Signs in the seeded demo accounts through POST /api/v1/auth/login (real accounts table, PBKDF2 hashes) and stores each token in the active environment (same variable names as `npm run token -- --postman`). Set the environment variable `demoPassword` to the DEMO_LOGIN_PASSWORD line of backend/.dev.vars (agreed demo password 1234567). Roles: CUSTOMER (mike, lerato), INSURER_ADMIN (admin_discovery, admin_sanlam), SUPERADMIN (superadmin).

request.description: Expected: 200 with a token for mike; stored in {{token_customer_a}}.
Expected: 200 with a token for lerato; stored in {{token_customer_b}}.
Expected: 200 with a token for admin_discovery; stored in {{token_insurer_a}}.
Expected: 200 with a token for admin_sanlam; stored in {{token_insurer_b}}.
Expected: 200 with a token for superadmin; stored in {{token_superadmin}}.
Expected: 200 {actor:{id:"user123",username:"mike",role:"CUSTOMER",tenantId:null,displayName:"Mike",status:"active"}}
Expected: 201 with a token (CUSTOMER); 409 username_taken on repeat; a role field -> 400

item.name: 0 - Unauthenticated (expect 401)
item.description: No token, or the retired Phase 0 dev headers. Every /api/v1 route must answer 401.

request.description: Expected: 401 {"error":"unauthenticated"}

item.name: GET my-covers with retired X-Dev-Actor headers

request.description: Expected: 401 - dev headers are no longer honoured

item.name: 1 - Customer A (user123)
item.description: Platform-level customer; owns claim_disc_101 (Discovery) and claim_sanlam_102 (Sanlam). Token: {{token_customer_a}}.

request.description: Expected: only user123 policies
Expected: claims owned by user123 across all insurers
Expected: 201 with a new claimId - copy it into the claimId variable for the wizard steps below
Expected: 200 while Draft / Info Needed; 409 payout_details_locked after submission. R4 200 claimed; account number is hashed, only last 4 stored
Expected: masked destination, latest decision, payout (if any)
Expected: 200 Draft -> Submitted; a second call answers 409
Expected: 200 only for a Rejected decision, else 409

item.name: 2 - Insurer admin, tenant A (ins_discovery)
item.description: Insurer staff of Discovery. Sees only submitted Discovery claims. Token: {{token_insurer_a}}.

request.description: Expected: only tenant_id = ins_discovery, no drafts, no user_id

item.name: GET timeline of a tenant claim

request.description: Expected: 200 { riskSignals: { classicalAnomaly, quantumAnomaly, anomalyBand, screeningRecommendation, versions, signalDigest, advisory: true } } or riskSignals null; audited screening.signal_read
Expected: the customer answers with PATCH screening

item.name: 3 - Insurer admin, tenant A: decide & pay
item.description: Manager of Discovery: decides (with a reason) and pays (simulated). Assessors can no longer decide (Phase 3). Token: {{token_insurer_a}}.

item.name: POST decide Approved (Review -> Decision, MANAGER only)

request.description: Expected: 200 with decisionId; approved amount defaults to the claimed amount (R4 200). Add "approvedAmountCents" for a partial approval

item.name: POST pay (Decision -> Paid, MANAGER only, simulated)

request.description: Expected: 200 {status:"paid", simulated:true, amountCents:420000}; repeat with the same Idempotency-Key -> 200 already_paid; without it -> 409
Expected: only claim_sanlam_102 (and other Sanlam claims)

item.name: 5 - Cross-tenant attack (expect 404)
item.description: Tenant B staff use a VALID token to reach a tenant A claim by id. The API must answer 404 (identical to a non-existent claim) and write an audit event.

request.description: Expected: 404, stage unchanged

item.name: Manager B tries to decide a Discovery claim

request.description: Expected: 404, stage unchanged

item.name: Manager B tries to pay a Discovery claim

request.description: Expected: 404

item.name: 8 - Phase 3 decision & payout attacks
item.description: Run after folder 1 initiate -> payout details -> screening -> submit and folder 2 verify -> screen -> review, with claimId set. Each request states the expected response.

request.description: Expected: 403 forbidden + audit authz.role_denied
Expected: 403 forbidden + audit claim.transition_rejected (role_not_permitted)
Expected: 409 illegal_transition (run while the claim is Submitted/Review)
Expected: 400 unrecognized_keys

item.name: DEMO 3: approve R420 000 on a R4 200 claim

request.description: Expected: 422 amount_exceeds_claimed + audit claim.decision_rejected

item.name: DEMO 3b: pay with a client-supplied amount

request.description: Expected: 400 client_supplied_fields + audit payout.blocked

item.name: DEMO 4: change payout destination after approval

request.description: Expected: 409 payout_details_locked + audit payout.destination_change_blocked
Expected: 404 not_found (identical to a non-existent claim)
Expected: 409 already_paid after a successful payout; same Idempotency-Key -> 200 already_paid, no second payout

item.name: 9 - Phase 4 quantum screening demo & attacks
item.description: Needs: npm run signals:import:local && npm run demo:quantum:local (before starting the server). Claims claim_demo_normal / claim_demo_unusual are synthetic, stage Verified, tenant ins_discovery.

request.description: Expected: 200, riskSignals.anomalyBand NORMAL, screeningRecommendation STANDARD_REVIEW
Expected: 200, anomalyBand HIGH, REVIEW_REQUIRED, explanation says "not a fraud finding"
Expected: 404 (no write route)
Expected: 400 unrecognized_keys
Expected: 403
Expected: 404 (audited cross_tenant)
Expected: 409 illegal_transition — the signal cannot move a claim
Expected: 200 Screening -> Review
Expected: 200; claim_decisions.risk_signal stores the band, scores and digest the manager saw

item.name: 10 - Phase 5 post-quantum decision integrity (ML-DSA-65)
item.description: Needs MLDSA_SEED in .dev.vars (npm run setup:local). Decide a claim first (folder 3), then verify it. To demo tampering, stop the server, edit claim_decisions in D1, restart (docs/security/evidence/live-demo-p5.sh).

request.description: Expected: 200 { alg: ML-DSA-65, keyId, publicKey (1952 bytes base64) }
Expected: 200 integrity.status VALID (TAMPERED after a direct DB edit)
Expected: 200 VALID
Expected: 404
Expected: 409 decision_integrity_failed when the signature does not verify

item.name: 11 - Integration pass: claim detail, evidence, spoofing attacks

request.description: Expected: 200 {claim:{id, stage, status, claimedAmountCents, payoutDestination (masked), insurerName, ...}}; never user_id
Pick a PDF/JPEG/PNG up to 10 MB. Expected: 201 {evidenceId, sha256} while the claim is Draft / Info Needed; 409 afterwards; 415 for a renamed .exe
Expected: 200 {evidence:[{id, display_name, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, created_at}]}

item.name: ATTACK-08 X-User-Id spoof (customer B pretends to be user123)

request.description: Expected: 404 not_found. Identity comes only from the verified token; the header is ignored.

item.name: ATTACK-09 X-Role spoof (customer claims to be an assessor)

request.description: Expected: 403 forbidden.

item.name: ATTACK-10 X-Tenant-Id spoof (Sanlam assessor claims Discovery)

request.description: Expected: 404 not_found.

Expected: 401. The pre-integration route that issued MANAGER tokens to anyone is gone.
